Jack’s calculation addresses my main concern: with everyone complying, the 15-ton/5-ton plan averages $12,500 each per month in the long run, despite occasional lower-income months.

I agree to catch no more than 15 tons this month if all five of us explicitly agree; otherwise, I’ll catch 10. I also commit to the 5-ton cap when we start with 50 tons under this agreement. Let’s review the actual stock and everyone’s revealed catches each month before renewing the plan—neither recovery nor compliance should be taken for granted.

Kate, you’re the remaining voice. Would you agree to those stock-dependent limits?
